same_day_repeat_atom.projection: only selected repeat durations become zero
same_day_repeat_atom.selection: select exactly round(q*repeat_count) repeat positions by ascending SHA256(seed:entity-fidelity-v5-same-day-atom:position), ties by position

generator.sampling: U=(bin+V)/3 with fresh independent V; linear inverse through frozen 32-knot marginals
generator.tie_rule: I=[count(x'<x)/n,count(x'<=x)/n]; cell mass is the mean product of fractional overlaps with thirds
